references.text: Also deals with sins committed in ignorance and bearing one's guilt, the same theme of 'bearing one's sin' (וְנָשָׂא עֲוֺנוֹ)
Concerns oaths and testimony in connection with sins against a neighbor
Describes one who hears an oath (אָלָה) but does not testify, and shall bear their sin
Uses the same expression 'bear one's guilt' (וְנָשָׂא עֲוֺנוֹ) for the one who sins
Same formulation about bearing one's guilt in cases of omission
Command not to bear sin because of a neighbor, related to responsibility for others
The penalty for one guilty of cursing (אָלָה)
The role and duty of witnesses to testify in legal proceedings
Requirement for witnesses in judicial processes
The high priest puts Jesus under oath to give testimony
Example of a solemn oath and the duty to testify
